summary: Class 7 ICSE Biology Topic 05: Human Circulatory System & Heart in the warm editorial aesthetic (#fbfaf7 ivory canvas, Newsreader serif, rich black #161514). Features double circulation (Pulmonary vs Systemic), 4-chambered heart anatomy and valves (Tricuspid, Bicuspid/Mitral, Semilunar), blood components (RBCs, WBCs, Platelets, Plasma), and Arteries vs Veins 5-point comparison matrix. Zero SVGs.
